description: This file defines the `GatewayDiscoveryModel` class, which manages discovery and tracking of gateway devices using Bonjour/mDNS service discovery within an iOS application. It includes data structures for gateways and debug logs, methods for starting/stopping discovery, and internal logic for updating state and logging.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: A final class conforming to @Observable that manages network discovery of gateways, maintains a list of discovered gateways, and provides debugging/logging functionalities.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DebugLogEntry
classes.description: A struct representing a log entry for debugging purposes, with timestamp, message, and unique ID.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: A struct representing a discovered gateway device, with properties such as name, endpoint, stable ID, and optional details like LAN host, ports, and TLS info.

methods.name: setDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging and manages the debug log array accordingly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins network discovery by creating browsers for each gateway service domain and setting up callbacks for state and result updates.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all active discovery browsers, clears internal states, and sets the status to 'Stopped'.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Updates the list of discovered gateways, comparing new results with previous ones to detect changes.

methods.name: updateStatusText
methods.description: Updates the current status text based on the network browsers' states.

methods.name: prettyState
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string describing a given NWBrowser.State.

methods.name: appendDebugLog
methods.description: Adds a message to the debug log with a timestamp, maintaining a maximum size.

methods.name: prettifyInstanceName
methods.description: Normalizes and cleans up device instance names for display purposes.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts a trimmed string value from a dictionary for a given key if it exists and is non-empty.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a dictionary for a given key, if possible.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Determines a boolean value from a dictionary for a given key based on common true string representations.
